assembly_instructions: 1. Set the open_frame_base on the floor at world y=0, then bolt in the left/right base rails, rear base rail, and four vertical frame posts. 2. Install the cyan residual_spine vertically through the center of the frame and connect it to the input_plate and embedding_table at the floor. 3. Slide the twelve visible layer cartridges onto the residual spine in order: three pale linear DeltaNet cartridges, one dark softmax cartridge, repeated three times to show the 3:1 pattern that scales to 192 layers. 4. Mount the DeltaNet subassembly on the left service rail: qkv_gate_projection feeds the deltanet_kernel, which updates the fixed-size state_torus and state_memory_capsule before returning through deltanet_output_projection. 5. Mount the softmax subassembly on the right service rail: softmax_qkv_projection feeds qk_norm_rope, softmax_attention_plate, kv_cache_tower with four cache_slices, and softmax_output_gate. 6. Attach the MoE bridge to the right side of every cartridge, then install the router disk, dispatch manifold, eight active expert cartridges, inactive expert bank, combine manifold, and copper all_to_all_ring. 7. Install the top output deck with prediction_head, mtp_head, lm_loss_marker, mode_think_plate, and mode_no_think_plate. 8. Add the long_context_module above the softmax side because DCA and YaRN act only on the softmax layers. 9. Connect the training_data_pipe into the input floor and the optimizer_adamw and post_train_pipeline modules to the frame service rail. 10. Verify that every non-root subsystem has a visible connection to either the frame, the residual spine, or the dataflow manifolds; no opaque enclosure hides two or more internal parts.

info.summary: PROJECTED next-generation flagship from Alibaba's Qwen team, extrapolated from the Qwen3 + Qwen3-Next research direction. No public paper at scene time. Best guess: scales Qwen3-Next's hybrid Gated DeltaNet (linear) + Gated Attention (softmax) pattern to flagship size. ~480B total / ~30B activated, 192 layers, 3:1 LINEAR:SOFTMAX attention ratio, 256 routed experts (top-8, no shared), QK-Norm + RoPE on softmax layers, MTP head, /think + /no_think modes preserved, 256K native context (1M with DCA + YaRN), 200+ languages. Treat numbers as plausible extrapolation, not fact.
info.description:
Qwen3.6 is presented here as a research-trajectory PROJECTION, not a paper. Where Qwen3-235B-A22B was full softmax + GQA(64/4) + 128 experts top-8, and where Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B introduced the Gated DeltaNet linear-attention + Gated Attention hybrid at small scale, Qwen3.6 likely (i) brings that hybrid to flagship scale (480B-A30B), (ii) doubles depth (94 → 192 layers — Qwen3-Next is already 48 layers narrow), (iii) doubles expert count (128 → 256), (iv) keeps GQA at extreme 16:1 in the few softmax layers, (v) adds an MTP head (Qwen3 lacked one; Qwen3-Coder added one — full family adoption), (vi) extends native context 32K → 256K with DCA + YaRN reaching 1M, (vii) keeps /think + /no_think system-tag modes.

Design rationale, in one line each:
• Gated DeltaNet (linear): O(N) attention for 75% of layers — KV-cache memory scales with layer count, not context length, on those layers.
• Keep some softmax: pure linear attention loses associative recall (the 'needle in a haystack' problem); 1-in-4 softmax layer restores it.
• Doubled experts (256): adds capacity at the same active-FLOPs budget.
• MTP added: ~1.8× speculative decoding for free.
• 192 layers: Qwen3-Next showed deep-narrow scaling holds; flagship inherits.

facts.label: context length
facts.value: 256 K native, 1 M with DCA + YaRN

facts.label: softmax heads
facts.value: 64 Q / 4 KV (GQA, ratio 16 — kept from Qwen3)

facts.label: precision
facts.value: FP8 GEMMs + BF16 master, INT4 KV (projected)

comparisons.delta: Qwen3-235B was full-softmax GQA(64/4) + 128 experts top-8 + no MTP, 94 layers. Projected Qwen3.6 doubles total params (235B → 480B), modestly grows activated (22B → 30B), DOUBLES depth (94 → 192), DOUBLES experts (128 → 256), introduces the 3:1 linear/softmax hybrid borrowed from Qwen3-Next, adds an MTP head, and pushes context from 32K-trained / 128K-extended to 256K-trained / 1M-extended. /think+/no_think modes preserved.

Qwen3-Next was the small (80B-A3B) Qwen3 prototype that introduced Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention at a 3:1 ratio over 48 layers. Qwen3.6 is the FLAGSHIP scaling of that recipe: 6× total params, 10× activated, 4× layers, but the same 3:1 hybrid pattern and the same DeltaNet kernel. Like Qwen3-Next, no shared expert.

Both are hybrid-attention reasoning MoEs. MiniMax pushes lightning attention to extreme ratios (projected 11:1 lightning:softmax). Qwen3.6 stays moderate at 3:1 — more softmax layers means better short-context quality at higher long-context KV cost. Qwen3.6's linear kernel is Gated DeltaNet (delta-rule with gating); MiniMax uses the Transnormer-style right-product linear attention. Different bets on the linear-attention design space.

V4-Pro keeps full-softmax everywhere but compresses + sparsifies via CSA + HCA + lightning indexer + top-k=1024. Qwen3.6 takes the orthogonal route: replace 75% of attention with O(N) linear attention. Both reach 1M-class context but with different cost profiles — V4 is read-bandwidth-bound on the indexer GEMM, Qwen3.6 is sequential-state-update-bound on the DeltaNet layers.

parts.name: Open Computation Frame Base
parts.role: Thin floor plate that roots the full assembly without hiding the token path or layer internals.

parts.name: Left Service Rail
parts.role: Left rail carries the DeltaNet state hardware and keeps it visibly outside the layer stack.

parts.name: Right Service Rail
parts.role: Right rail carries softmax cache and MoE dispatch modules outside the main residual tower.

parts.name: Rear Cross Rail
parts.role: Rear cross rail squares the open frame while leaving the front cut away for inspection.

parts.name: Front Left Frame Post
parts.role: Vertical post showing the frame height and keeping the front-left corner open around the layer cartridges.

parts.name: Front Right Frame Post
parts.role: Vertical post supporting the MoE side bridge without enclosing the transformer layers.

parts.name: Rear Left Frame Post
parts.role: Rear post gives the tower depth while preserving a cutaway front view.

parts.name: Rear Right Frame Post
parts.role: Rear post ties the softmax and MoE side modules back to the main frame.

parts.name: Top Output Cross Rail
parts.role: Top rail mechanically ties the four posts and carries the final LM head deck.

parts.name: Input Tokens (V≈152K, 200+ langs)
parts.role: Multilingual BPE token floor where token ids enter before embedding lookup.

parts.name: Embedding Table (V≈152K, d=4096)
parts.role: Tied embedding lookup that converts token ids into the d=4096 residual stream.

parts.name: Residual Stream Spine (d=4096)
parts.role: Central vertical residual path through the projected 192 pre-norm transformer layers.

parts.name: Layer Ruler: 192 Total
parts.role: Scale bar marking that the twelve visible cartridges are samples of 192 total layers.

parts.name: Layer 001 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: First visible Gated DeltaNet block using linear recurrent attention instead of a context-length KV cache.

parts.name: Layer 002 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Second linear block in the repeating three-linear sequence.

parts.name: Layer 003 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Third linear block before the first full softmax recovery layer.

parts.name: Layer 004 - SOFTMAX Gated Attention
parts.role: First full attention layer restores associative recall with GQA 64Q/4KV and a gated output.

parts.name: Layer 005 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Linear layer sample showing the repeated DeltaNet path after a softmax recovery layer.

parts.name: Layer 006 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Middle DeltaNet layer sample in the second 3:1 attention group.

parts.name: Layer 007 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Third DeltaNet layer before the second softmax sample.

parts.name: Layer 008 - SOFTMAX Gated Attention
parts.role: Second visible softmax recovery layer, one of the projected 48 softmax layers.

parts.name: Layer 189 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Compressed top-of-stack sample showing that the late layers still follow the linear attention majority.

parts.name: Layer 190 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Late-stage DeltaNet layer sample immediately below the final pair.

parts.name: Layer 191 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Final linear layer sample before the last softmax layer.

parts.name: Layer 192 - Final SOFTMAX
parts.role: Final attention layer before the tied LM head, preserving associative recall at the top of the stack.

parts.name: DeltaNet Service Arm
parts.role: Cantilever arm physically connects the left-side DeltaNet modules to the open frame.

parts.name: DeltaNet QKV plus Alpha-Gate Projection
parts.role: Projection tile emits Q, K, V, and a sigmoid alpha gate for each token before recurrent state update.

parts.name: Gated DeltaNet Kernel
parts.role: Linear attention kernel applies the delta-rule state update with per-token cost independent of context length.
parts.bottleneck: Sequential state update during decode; chunked prefill recovers partial parallelism.

parts.name: Fixed-Size DeltaNet State Ring
parts.role: Visible ring marks the recurrent S state that replaces a long KV cache for 144 linear layers.
parts.memory_footprint: ≈1 MB per sequence per layer, independent of token count

parts.name: DeltaNet State Memory Capsule
parts.role: Compact memory vessel showing that DeltaNet storage scales with layers and batch, not with context length.

parts.name: DeltaNet Output Projection
parts.role: Projects DeltaNet output back to d=4096 before the residual add.

parts.name: Softmax Service Arm
parts.role: Right-side arm connects the softmax inspection modules to the frame and layer stack.

parts.name: Softmax QKV Projection GQA 64Q/4KV
parts.role: Projection tile generates 64 query heads and 4 shared KV heads for the softmax layers.

parts.name: QK-Norm and RoPE Stage
parts.role: Normalizes query and key vectors and applies rotary position embedding before attention.

parts.name: Gated Softmax Attention Plate
parts.role: Full causal softmax attention plate for the 48 recovery layers that retain associative recall.

parts.name: Softmax KV Cache Tower
parts.role: Visible cache tower stores GQA KV tensors only for the 48 softmax layers.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 0-64K
parts.role: First visible cache slice representing the initial 64K portion of native 256K context.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 64-128K
parts.role: Second visible cache slice representing the next 64K native context segment.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 128-192K
parts.role: Third visible cache slice representing the 128K to 192K context range.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 192-256K
parts.role: Fourth visible cache slice completing the projected 256K native window.

parts.name: Softmax Output Gate
parts.role: Learned gate scales the softmax attention output before returning it to the residual stream.

parts.name: Per-Layer MoE Bridge
parts.role: Vertical bridge shows that every transformer layer routes through a per-layer MoE feed-forward block.

parts.name: Top-8 Softmax Router
parts.role: Router disk scores 256 experts and selects the top eight for each token with loss-free balance bias.

parts.name: Expert Dispatch Manifold
parts.role: NCCL dispatch bar sends token groups from the router to the selected expert cartridges.

parts.name: Active Expert 1 of Top-8
parts.role: One selected SwiGLU expert cartridge from the projected 256 routed experts.

parts.name: Active Expert 2 of Top-8
parts.role: Second selected expert showing top-8 activation rather than a single shared expert.

parts.name: Active Expert 3 of Top-8
parts.role: Third selected SwiGLU expert with intermediate dimension around 1536.

parts.name: Active Expert 4 of Top-8
parts.role: Fourth selected expert in the per-token sparse feed-forward path.

parts.name: Active Expert 5 of Top-8
parts.role: Fifth selected expert cartridge, making the top-8 routing count visible.

parts.name: Active Expert 6 of Top-8
parts.role: Sixth selected expert in the activated 30B-parameter token path.

parts.name: Active Expert 7 of Top-8
parts.role: Seventh active expert, separated from the inactive bank to avoid hiding the sparse route.

parts.name: Active Expert 8 of Top-8
parts.role: Eighth selected expert completes the top-8 sparse activation set.

parts.name: Inactive Expert Bank: Remaining 248 of 256
parts.role: Thin background disk marks the full 256-expert pool while the eight selected cartridges remain exposed.

parts.name: Expert Combine Manifold
parts.role: Combine bar gathers weighted expert outputs and sends them back to the residual stream.

parts.name: Expert All-to-All Communication Ring
parts.role: Copper ring represents the NCCL all-to-all network used for expert dispatch and combine.

parts.name: DCA plus YaRN Long-Context Module
parts.role: Dual-Chunk Attention and YaRN extension module applies only to softmax layers to reach projected 1M context.

parts.name: Tied LM Head
parts.role: Tied output projection maps the final residual state back to the approximately 152K-token vocabulary.

parts.name: MTP Head Depth 1
parts.role: Projected multi-token prediction head supports speculative decoding with one extra future-token target.

parts.name: LM Loss and Reward Head Marker
parts.role: Small output marker represents next-token cross-entropy during pre-training and reward-optimized post-training objectives.

parts.name: Mode Plate: /think
parts.role: System-tag mode plate indicates reasoning traces are enabled while using the same shared weights.

parts.name: Mode Plate: /no_think
parts.role: System-tag mode plate indicates direct-answer decoding while preserving the same model weights.

parts.name: ~50T-Token Multilingual Data Pipe
parts.role: Input-side data pipe represents the projected 50T-token multilingual pre-training corpus.

parts.name: AdamW Optimizer Module
parts.role: Training-side module represents AdamW with sharded optimizer state across data-parallel workers.

parts.name: SFT, RLHF, Reasoning-RL and Long-Output RL
parts.role: Post-training pipeline module refines instruction following, reasoning mode, and long-output behavior after pre-training.

parts.name: TP x EP x PP x DP Backplane
parts.role: Rear backplane labels the distributed execution plan tying tensor, expert, pipeline, and data parallelism together.
